title: A to Z Islamic Quiz (Part 1)
caption:
A to Z Islamic Quiz: how many can you get?

25 letters, 25 questions about the Qur'an, the Prophet's life and the pillars of Islam. Pause if you need more time, and be honest with your score.

Comment your score out of 25 and share it with a friend who thinks they know it all.
